headlines.text: That Saturday in 2024, the AEW World Trios Titles changed hands as The Patriarchy vs. Gunns & Robinson battled it out, appearing on Collision, rated 6.56 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. For The Patriarchy and Gunns & Robinson, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. This stood as the 30th match in AEW World Trios Titles history ? a real landmark for that championship. Shayna Wayne's interference proved decisive as the newly-renamed Killswitch and Christian Cage crowned The Patriarchy new AEW World Trios Champions over the Bang Bang Gang.
Back on this day in 2022, it was Cole Karter's first night in AEW against Ricky Starks, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.78.
Turning the clock back to 2022: it was Moxley & Yuta's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.20 ? a match that delivered.

secondaries.text: That Wednesday in 2022, it was a welcome sight as Jade Cargill returned to the ring after 7 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.

Looking back to 2022, when Brody King vs. Darby Allin locked horns for the first time, setting the tone as the night's opener on Dynamite, rated 7.63 ? a well-worked match.
